# Recon map: Slotly (web)

Scope: the public booking page and the guest booking flow
For: freelancers who hate per-seat pricing
Date: 2026-10-20

## Screens

| ID | screen | route / how to reach | purpose | key components | states seen |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S01 | booking page | /u/<host>/<event> | guest picks a day | day strip, slot grid | empty week, filled, loading |
| S02 | pick a time | same page, day chosen | guest picks a slot | slot grid, timezone picker | no slots, filled |
| S03 | details form | same page, slot chosen | name and email | form, confirm button | error, filled |
| S04 | confirmed | /booked/<id> | the receipt | summary card, add-to-calendar | default |

## Flows

```
FL01 Guest books a slot
    S01 -> S02 -> S03 -> S04
    happy path clicks: 4
    edge: no slots this week, time zone differs, slot taken while filling the form
```

## Components

| component | variants | states | used on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Slot button | default, taken | default, hover, focus, disabled | S02 |

content.text:
S02 is built: picking a day now fills a grid of one button per open slot, and a day with no slots shows "No open slots that day." The JS passes a syntax check, but I haven't opened the page in a browser. I also haven't committed anything.

I matched the original's structure, not its code. The original is a 4-column grid of time buttons under a heading. I used a responsive grid that fits as many columns as the width allows, with Bookly's own colour and spacing tokens. Its `#006bff` blue, class names, copy, fonts and `widget.js` script stay out. They're Slotly's expression, and this is a clone, so copying them would be a problem, not parity.

The changes are in `bookly/app.js` (a `.slot` button per time), `bookly/styles.css` (grid, focus ring, disabled style) and `bookly/index.html` (comment only). I also added an S02 line to `TICKETS.md` marked done.

The recon map lists a timezone picker and a "taken" slot variant for S02. I added a disabled style for taken slots, but nothing sets that state yet, and there's no timezone picker. Both need their own tickets if you want them by Friday.
